notes.title: May 26th Patch
notes.notes:
Fix crash that could occur on the cockpit screen when switching submenus
 Increase weapon bonus yield from 4x to 5x to make early game easier
 Hitting asteroids no longer stuns the player, however you will still bounce off of them
 Add extra explanatory text to the price chart screen

notes.title: May 17 2025 Hotfix
notes.notes:
This update fixes a major bug that prevented progress in the game introduced in the last update. I am terribly sorry for any inconvenience caused by the last update and I will strive to be more thorough in my testing in the future.

In addition, enemy counts in the first few turns have been reduced, and the pinball mechanic is a little less punishing.

notes.title: May 14th Patch Notes
notes.notes: Flesh out help text to make it more comprehensive and clearer

notes.title: May 13th Patch
notes.notes:
Fix incorrect window icon
 Fix Windows cursor being invisible when dragging or resizing window
 Increase invulnerability time after taking damage to be less punishing
